name: yt-dlp: YouTube + SoundCloud
description: Search and stream YouTube and SoundCloud through your own yt-dlp. Audio is lossy (Opus/AAC/MP3). Also suggests what to play next.
author: Lumen
setup: Install yt-dlp (Arch: pacman -S yt-dlp) and keep it updated. Using it may break a site's terms of service; that's your call. Optional sign-in: YouTube sometimes refuses anonymous downloads ("sign in to confirm you're not a bot"). Signing in is at your own risk: YouTube can restrict an account that is used with downloaders, so consider a separate account.

options.label: Sign in to YouTube using your browser
options.hint: Pick the browser you are signed in to YouTube with. yt-dlp reads that browser's YouTube login on this computer when it needs it; Lumen never sees or stores it. Signing in lets more songs play, and adds your own YouTube recommendations to Up Next.

options.label: ...or a cookies.txt file
options.hint: Path to a cookies.txt exported from your browser. Used instead of the browser above when set.
